correctness.rationale: For each nonconstant affine word choose smallest active digit j. Each pQ block has exactly one Q-long zero interval; isolated boundary merges produce Q or 2Q runs. Cyclic shifting upper digits removes constant c from join statistic. Carry transitions give M=1_{H_(s−1)=1}+(p−1)Σ_(t=0)^(s−2)p^(s−t−2)1_{H_t=1}; triangular H map is bijective and F_s product counts all vectors. Multiplicity p(p−1) and constant words give full distribution for p odd, m>=2, all b. Independently enumerated all codewords for p3m2,p3m3,p5m2 and all b; general claim rests on proof.
